---
title: "check-format-output-files.yml"
---

Fails when a Quarto page lacks an `output-file` for a format
that the repository's publish renders with `quarto render --to FORMAT`.
`--to FORMAT` renders every page, including one whose `format:` omits FORMAT,
and names the output after the page.
A page with no `revealjs` entry therefore writes its slide deck to `<stem>.html`,
replacing the notes page.
This happened to `linear-algebra.html`, `algebra.html` and `calculus.html` in
[mds](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/mds/pull/508).

For each page with front matter, and each format in `formats`,
the page must list the format under `format:` and give it an `output-file`.
Subfiles (names starting with `_`) and `_extensions/**` are skipped.
It fails by default; `fail: false` gives warning annotations only.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formats` | `revealjs pdf docx` | Formats the publish renders with `--to` |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-format-output-files.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-format-output-files.yml`.
